name: timer-wrap
gui: SystemView 4.10b, ci.lan, 2026-10-23; wrapped reuses the verified 2026-10-22 export

wrap_evidence.reason: The only Init is at byte 12. The decoder starts relative time at zero, so a contiguous slice retaining Init and crossing 2^32 must retain every preceding delta. The minimal prefix is only 16 gzip bytes smaller than this fixture; deleting the middle would falsify the timer history.
